rule: Exactly one verdict per current active package. No grouped packages. No historical packages.

ENGINEERING_DEFINITION.question: Is the engineering definition sufficient for evaluation?
ENGINEERING_DEFINITION.evidence_required: Domain-specific engineering core with equations, parameters, failure modes

EVIDENCE.question: Is the evidence traceable and properly classified?

DESIGN_OUTPUTS.question: Are design outputs defined (not just inputs)?
DESIGN_OUTPUTS.evidence_required: Design outputs with status (ABSENT / CONCEPTUAL / MODELLED)

MANUFACTURING.question: Is manufacturing readiness honestly stated (not fabricated)?
MANUFACTURING.evidence_required: Manufacturing candidate processes with UNKNOWN tolerances

REGULATORY.question: Is the regulatory pathway honestly stated (not contradictory)?
REGULATORY.evidence_required: Regulatory pathway marked UNKNOWN with resolution plan

BUYER_EVALUABILITY.question: Can a buyer make a rational decision from this package alone?
BUYER_EVALUABILITY.evidence_required: Transfer manifest + engineering artifact status + build plan

TRANSFERABILITY.question: Is the transfer boundary clear (what exists vs what buyer must build)?
TRANSFERABILITY.evidence_required: Transfer boundary with TRANSFERABLE_NOW / BUYER_MUST_DEVELOP / NOT_AVAILABLE

COMMERCIALIZATION.question: Is there a credible party that can take this technology forward?
COMMERCIALIZATION.evidence_required: Market context, buyer type, commercialization path

final_per_package_verdict.requires: One verdict per package with justification
